title: pinvoke.net auxiliary API row
description: One API name the pinvoke.net P/Invoke reference wiki documents (knowledge/aux/, the isolated weak-auxiliary layer -- NOT part of the kb/ specification).  name is the page's function/structure name, module is the wiki section the name is filed under, dll is the name its DllImport line prints (empty when the page prints none), header is DERIVED from the module and is weak evidence by design (page_parse.pinvoke_header_from_module): it exists so the corpus' constant/header linkage can take a hint where the official documentation states nothing, and it is always consumed as the weakest rank, labelled.  Two accept paths feed this table, both isolated (docs/COLLECTION-POLICY.md): the pinvoke.net user wiki under corpus/pinvoke/ (queue-gated), and the pinned github.com/dotnet/pinvoke snapshot under sources/dotnet-pinvoke/ (MIT, parsed by tools/pinvoke_extract.py -- its records quote the verbatim .cs line and carry source.archive_member + source.line, with value_eval as a marked best-effort fold).
